query_analysis.original_query: We're investigating a novel hybrid membrane-adsorption process for hydrogen sulfide removal from sour gas. How can we develop a multi-scale modeling approach to predict separation performance?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a comprehensive multi-scale modeling framework to simulate and predict the performance of a novel hybrid membrane-adsorption system for selective hydrogen sulfide removal from sour gas streams.

selected_agents.role: Hybrid process configuration and mechanism elucidation
Multi-scale model development and numerical solution
Membrane permeation and adsorption equilibrium analysis

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative model refinement and performance prediction
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated process understanding and numerical implementation

clarification_questions: What are the specific characteristics and composition of the sour gas stream?
